integrity: The formula is proved by an exact sum-product reduction, quadratic-character pair counts, and a standard quadratic Jacobi-sum identity. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact additive-energy and constant-input fourth-moment formula; it does not claim the sharp L2-to-L4 operator norm for the quartic graph.
Finite replay covers 24 prime fields through 101 and three quadratic extension fields; the proof covers all finite fields in the stated characteristics.
Residual originality risk remains for obscure or unindexed finite-field additive-combinatorics calculations.
title: Exact additive energy of the finite-field quartic graph
